title: 65 Cartron Drive, Athlone, Co. Westmeath
description:
Property Partners Moore Larkin are delighted to offer for rent 65 Cartron Drive, Athlone. This is a superb four bedroom semi-detached home, neatly tucked away in a cul de sac within this popular development. 
The property consists of the following accommodation; front sitting room, loving room, kitchen, downstairs bedroom, utility, shower room. Upstairs; Three bedrooms and family bathroom. Externally the property also has a domestic garage in the rear garden. The property has the benefit of both oil fired central heating and a wood pellet stove.
The property is well located on the local town bus route, close the TUS Campus Athlone and a host of large employers on Athlone`s east side.
Viewings are strictly by appointment with sole agent.
